paint.prompt: a rough wall of grey-brown fieldstones of many sizes laid in thick lime mortar, chipped and weathered, darkened by smoke and soot toward the top, dusty at the foot

description: Section of rough fieldstone wall facing, 1.92 m wide x 3.45 m tall x ~0.2 m deep, for lining a room: rubble stones in rough courses over a recessed lime-mortar core, smoke-darkened upward from ~1.5 m. Front -Y, back flat at +Y against the room's wall; side edges cut straight to butt against other sections.
